Jahnavi Vadla

vadlajahnavi2906@gmail.com | +91 6301690980 | www.linkedin.com/in/jahnavivadla

ServiceNow Developer | CSA & CAD Certified | ITSM, CSM, Service Portal, Integrations & Flow Designer

SUMMARY

ServiceNow Developer with 4+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development, administration, configuration, implementation, integrations, and production support across ITSM and CSM environments. ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and Certified System Administrator (CSA), with hands-on expertise in Service Catalog, Record Producers, Order Guides, Service Portal, custom widgets, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, REST APIs, App Engine Studio, ACLs, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, Transform Maps, Import Sets, and Scheduled Jobs. Experienced in developing custom applications, automating business processes, configuring platform capabilities, supporting UAT and deployments, and troubleshooting production issues. Strong experience working across the software delivery lifecycle, including requirement gathering, development, testing, deployment, and post-production support in Agile environments.

EDUCATION

Keshav Memorial Institute of Technology Bachelor of Technology (Electronics and Communication Engineering), CGPA: 7.62

Year of Graduation: 2022

KEY STRENGTHS:

ServiceNow Administration | CAD | ITSM | CSM | Custom Application Development | REST Integrations | IntegrationHub | Flow Designer | Service Catalog | Service Portal | App Engine Studio | JavaScript | Production Support

EXPERIENCE

ServiceNow Developer PwC Project: Life Point (August 2025 – Present)

August 2025 – Present Bangalore

Develop and enhance ServiceNow Service Catalog capabilities including Catalog Items, Record Producers, and Order Guides to support enterprise service-request processes.

Customize Service Portal pages and widgets and enhance user-facing experiences using HTML, CSS, and AngularJS.

Develop and configure REST API integrations and leverage IntegrationHub capabilities for system integration and data exchange.

Build Flow Designer automations and Decision Table logic to streamline business processes and reduce manual activities.

Configure Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, Catalog Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, and Server-Side Scripts based on business requirements.

Configure Import Sets, Transform Maps, Scheduled Jobs, Email Notifications, and Email Scripts for data processing and platform automation.

Develop and maintain Reports, Dashboards, and Performance Analytics to support operational visibility. • Participate in requirement gathering, Agile ceremonies, development, testing, UAT, deployment, and production support activities.

Troubleshoot application and platform issues and support post-deployment stabilization and defect resolution.

ServiceNow Developer Virtusa Consulting Services Pvt. Ltd.

May 2022 – July 2025 Bangalore

Project: UK Based Insurance Client (June 2022 – January 2024)

• Developed and configured custom ServiceNow applications, tables, ACLs, and application

components using App Engine Studio.

Developed Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, Notifications, Scheduled Jobs, and server-side scripting to implement business requirements.

Configured and enhanced Service Catalog, Service Portal, workflow automation, and data migration capabilities.

Implemented ServiceNow integrations and supported data exchange and synchronization requirements.

Executed data migration activities using Import Sets and Transform Maps, including data validation and troubleshooting.

Supported application testing, UAT, deployment, production support, and issue resolution. • Collaborated with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver ServiceNow enhancements in an Agile environment.

ServiceNow Developer Virtusa Consulting Services Pvt. Ltd. Project: UK Based Retail Client (February 2024 – July 2025)

May 2022 – July 2025 Bangalore

Administered and supported ServiceNow ITSM processes including Incident, Change, Problem, and Service Request Management.

Managed users, groups, roles, ACLs, access controls, and platform configuration as part of day-to-day ServiceNow administration.

Configured Client Scripts, Business Rules, UI Policies, Notifications, Approvals, SLAs, and Transform Maps.

Supported production troubleshooting, testing, access management, platform maintenance, and issue resolution.

Worked with stakeholders to analyze requirements and implement ServiceNow configuration and enhancement requests.

Intern Virtusa Consulting Services Pvt. Ltd.

January 2022 – May 2022 Bangalore

Completed ServiceNow training and gained foundational knowledge of the ServiceNow platform, ITSM processes, Service Catalog, workflows, administration concepts, navigation, and scripting fundamentals.

Participated in hands-on learning exercises and platform familiarization activities as part of the ServiceNow onboarding program.

CERTIFICATIONS

ServiceNow Mainline Certifications

Certified System Administrator (CSA) • Certified Application Developer (CAD)

ServiceNow Micro Certifications

Flow Designer • App Engine Studio Integration Hub •

TECHNICAL SKILLS

ServiceNow Administration: Platform Configuration, User/Role Management, ACLs, Notifications, Scheduled Jobs, Reports & Dashboards, Data Management, Production Support

ServiceNow Development: Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, Catalog Client Scripts, UI Policies, Catalog UI Policies, UI Actions, Server-Side Scripting, Email Scripts

ServiceNow Modules: ITSM, CSM, Service Catalog, Service Portal, Application Development

Automation: Flow Designer, Decision Tables, Workflow Automation, Scheduled Jobs

Integrations: REST APIs, IntegrationHub, Transform Maps, Import Sets, Data Sources

Application Development: App Engine Studio, Custom Applications, Custom Tables, ACLs, Service Portal Widgets

UX / Portal: Service Portal, Custom Widgets, HTML, CSS, AngularJS

Reporting: Reports, Dashboards, Performance Analytics

Delivery: Agile/Scrum, Requirement Gathering, UAT, Deployment, Production Support

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
EXPERIENCE
ServiceNow Developer PwC Project: Life Point (August 2025 – Present)
August 2025 – Present Bangalore
Develop and enhance ServiceNow Service Catalog capabilities including Catalog Items, Record Producers, and Order Guides to support enterprise service-request processes.
Customize Service Portal pages and widgets and enhance user-facing experiences using HTML, CSS, and AngularJS.
Develop and configure REST API integrations and leverage IntegrationHub capabilities for system integration and data exchange.
Build Flow Designer automations and Decision Table logic to streamline business processes and reduce manual activities.
Configure Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, Catalog Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, and Server-Side Scripts based on business requirements.
Configure Import Sets, Transform Maps, Scheduled Jobs, Email Notifications, and Email Scripts for data processing and platform automation.
Develop and maintain Reports, Dashboards, and Performance Analytics to support operational visibility. • Participate in requirement gathering, Agile ceremonies, development, testing, UAT, deployment, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot application and platform issues and support post-deployment stabilization and defect resolution.
ServiceNow Developer Virtusa Consulting Services Pvt. Ltd.
May 2022 – July 2025 Bangalore
Project: UK Based Insurance Client (June 2022 – January 2024)
• Developed and configured custom ServiceNow applications, tables, ACLs, and application
components using App Engine Studio.
Developed Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, Notifications, Scheduled Jobs, and server-side scripting to implement business requirements.
Configured and enhanced Service Catalog, Service Portal, workflow automation, and data migration capabilities.
Implemented ServiceNow integrations and supported data exchange and synchronization requirements.
Executed data migration activities using Import Sets and Transform Maps, including data validation and troubleshooting.
Supported application testing, UAT, deployment, production support, and issue resolution. • Collaborated with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver ServiceNow enhancements in an Agile environment.
ServiceNow Developer Virtusa Consulting Services Pvt. Ltd. Project: UK Based Retail Client (February 2024 – July 2025)
May 2022 – July 2025 Bangalore
Administered and supported ServiceNow ITSM processes including Incident, Change, Problem, and Service Request Management.
Managed users, groups, roles, ACLs, access controls, and platform configuration as part of day-to-day ServiceNow administration.
Configured Client Scripts, Business Rules, UI Policies, Notifications, Approvals, SLAs, and Transform Maps.
Supported production troubleshooting, testing, access management, platform maintenance, and issue resolution.
Worked with stakeholders to analyze requirements and implement ServiceNow configuration and enhancement requests.
Intern Virtusa Consulting Services Pvt. Ltd.
January 2022 – May 2022 Bangalore
Completed ServiceNow training and gained foundational knowledge of the ServiceNow platform, ITSM processes, Service Catalog, workflows, administration concepts, navigation, and scripting fundamentals.
Participated in hands-on learning exercises and platform familiarization activities as part of the ServiceNow onboarding program.
